summary_en: IMURA & Co. authorized acquisition of up to 100,000 shares (0.99% of shares outstanding excluding treasury stock) for a maximum of ¥1.0 billion from September 15, 2026 through January 29, 2027 to enhance capital efficiency and shareholder returns.
title_en: Notice Regarding Determination of Matters Concerning Acquisition of Treasury Stock
translation_en_brief:
On September 14, 2026, IMURA & Co.'s Board of Directors authorized the acquisition of treasury stock. The company may acquire up to 100,000 ordinary shares, representing 0.99% of issued shares excluding treasury stock, for a maximum consideration of ¥1.0 billion. The acquisition period runs from September 15, 2026 through January 29, 2027.

The stated purpose is to pursue flexible capital allocation in response to changes in the operating environment while enhancing capital efficiency and enriching shareholder returns. At the authorization date, the company held 708,205 treasury shares against 10,021,165 issued shares excluding treasury stock.
